title: Import STEP Shapes as CAD Fixtures
description: Import hexagonal-cut-concrete-forest left/right STEP files into spatial.shape CAD play fixtures with raw BREP topology importer.
summary:
Added raw Rhino STEP BREP import to the brepjs kernel and generated two CAD play fixtures from semio kit STEP sources.

- importStepBrepToModelSpace walks imported brep topology into spatial.shape kernel graph (vertices through solids)
- importStepToModelSpace falls back to raw BREP import when spatial UDA metadata is absent
- inlineModelSpaceFixtureJson serializes inline spatial.modelspace/v1 play fixtures
- Vitest validates both STEP files (57 faces, positive volume, tessellation, JSON round-trip) and generates fixtures via CAD_GENERATE_STEP_FIXTURES
- script.ts fixture command + launch.json entry; play navbar wired for Concrete forest (left/right)

Tests: @cad/js/kernel/brepjs 35 passed. @cad/js/renderer build succeeded.
